Job description:
Hiring an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineer. About us, we are an AI startup working on products and services for automating organizational processes, intelligent assistants for responding to and performing tasks, smart quality control of products, improving organizational efficiency and agility using advanced AI technologies. If you find working in a startup appealing and want to be part of an energetic and friendly team, we would be happy to add you to our group.

Our job description is looking for an AI Engineer who is interested in designing and developing intelligent systems based on Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, and Agentic systems.

AI and LLM Skills and Experience: Mastery of basic Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning concepts, proficiency in Python programming language, deep familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), practical experience in designing and implementing RAG systems, mastery of Prompt Engineering concepts, experience with Tool Calling and Function Calling, familiarity with the design and implementation of AI Agents and Multi-Agent Systems, familiarity with LLM Workflow and Agent Orchestration.

AI and Framework Libraries: Experience with some of the following tools and libraries: LangChain, LangGraph, FastAPI, Pydantic, Pandas / NumPy, Vector Databases, and Vector Search.

Backend and Software Engineering: Mastery of REST API design and development, familiarity with software design principles and service architecture, experience with relational databases like PostgreSQL, familiarity with graph databases like Neo4j, experience with Vector Databases and Semantic Search systems, familiarity with Git and team development processes, familiarity with Linux and Docker.

Personal Attributes: Ability to solve complex problems and analyze issues, interest in learning and researching new AI technologies, ability to study technical documentation and specialized articles, responsibility and follow-through to the result, teamwork skills, orderliness and accuracy in software development, creativity, and the ability to turn ideas into real products.

Special Advantages: The following are considered special advantages:
• Having practical experience in the field of LLM, RAG, or AI Agent.
• Experience developing real-world AI products.
• Experience working with databases and data management tools.

Working Hours and Collaboration Type: • Saturday to Wednesday, 9 AM to 6 PM.
• In-person full-time collaboration.
• Negotiable salary.

If building intelligent systems, working with LLMs, and turning new AI technologies into real products is attractive to you, we would be happy to get to know you.

Company description:
The company Behin Pardazh Afaq Novin Pars, doing business as AIOPT, was established with the aim of providing advanced artificial intelligence solutions for optimizing organizational processes. We utilize our expertise in artificial intelligence and machine learning to help organizations achieve greater efficiency, reduce costs, and improve decision-making. We know ourselves as an AI startup that wants to provide AI-based optimization solutions for various industries.
